(3)
Every regulation made under subsection (1), shall
be published in the Gazette and shall come into operation
on the date of such publication or on such later date as may
be specified in such regulation.

(4)
Every regulation made under subsection (1), shall
within three months after its publication in the Gazette be
brought before Parliament for approval and any regulation
which is not so approved shall be deemed to be rescinded
with effect from the date of such disapproval, but without
prejudice to anything previously done thereunder.

(5)
  Any  regulation  made  by  the  Minister  with
concurrence  of  the  Commission  may  at  any  time,  be
amended, added to, varied or rescinded by a like regulation.
